title: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Master
about: Saarland University's Data Science and Artificial Intelligence master's at the Saarland Informatics Campus takes applications for the summer semester until November 15 and for the winter semester until May 15. Summer-semester applicants can expect a decision by mid-January at the latest.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related subject
English language skills at an advanced level (usually C1)
Apply through the computer science department's online application system
Complete applications received after the deadline are considered automatically in the next semester's decision round

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: "Machine learning" (record skill) → "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
"Data science" (record skill) → "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
